summary: Genenta Science S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K summarizing its July 29, 2026 Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting. The name change to Saentra Forge S.p.A. was deferred to a reconvened meeting on September 10-11, 2026. Shareholders approved a five-year board authorization to increase share capital by up to €300 million, issue up to 120 million new shares, and issue convertible bonds, plus a reverse stock split ratio between 1-for-10 and 1-for-20 to maintain Nasdaq minimum bid price compliance. These authorizations signal potential future capital raises or strategic transactions, but no specific deal was announced. Watch for board decisions on the reverse split ratio and any capital issuance terms.
